nth-highest-salary: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS "getNthHighestSalary(2)";
rank-scores: SELECT Score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Score DESC) AS Rank FROM Scores ORDER BY Score DESC;
consecutive-numbers: SELECT DISTINCT l1.Num AS ConsecutiveNums FROM Logs l1 JOIN Logs l2 ON l1.Id = l2.Id - 1 JOIN Logs l3 ON l2.Id = l3.Id - 1 WHERE l1.Num = l2.Num AND l2.Num = l3.Num;
customers-who-never-order: SELECT Name AS Customers FROM Customers WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Orders);
employees-earning-more-than-their-manage: SELECT e1.Name AS Employee FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e1.ManagerId = e2.Id WHERE e1.Salary > e2.Salary;
department-highest-salary: SELECT d.Name AS Department, e.Name AS Employee, e.Salary FROM Department d JOIN Employee e ON d.Id = e.DepartmentId WHERE (e.DepartmentId, e.Salary) IN (SELECT DepartmentId, MAX(Salary) FROM Employee GROUP BY DepartmentId);
rising-temperature: SELECT w1.Id FROM Weather w1 JOIN Weather w2 ON julianday(w1.recordDate) - julianday(w2.recordDate) = 1 WHERE w1.Temperature > w2.Temperature;
delete-duplicate-emails: DELETE FROM Person WHERE Id IN (SELECT p1.Id FROM Person p1 JOIN Person p2 ON p1.Email = p2.Email AND p1.Id > p2.Id); SELECT Id, Email FROM Person ORDER BY Id;
trips-and-users: SELECT t.request_at AS Day, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status != 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Cancellation Rate" FROM Trips t JOIN Users u ON t.client_id = u.users_id AND u.banned = 'No' WHERE t.request_at BETWEEN '2013-10-01' AND '2013-10-03' GROUP BY t.request_at;
median-employee-salary: WITH ranked AS (SELECT id, company, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY company) AS cnt FROM Employee) SELECT id, company, salary FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);
find-median-given-frequency-of-numbers: WITH expanded AS (SELECT num, SUM(frequency) OVER (ORDER BY num) AS cum, SUM(frequency) OVER () AS total FROM Numbers) SELECT AVG(num) AS median FROM Numbers WHERE num IN (SELECT num FROM expanded WHERE cum >= (total + 1) / 2 INTERSECT SELECT num FROM expanded WHERE cum >= (total + 2) / 2);
get-highest-answer-rate-question: SELECT question_id AS survey_log FROM SurveyLog GROUP BY question_id ORDER BY CAST(COUNT(answer_id) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1;
find-cumulative-salary-of-an-employee: WITH filtered AS (SELECT e1.id, e1.month, e1.salary FROM Employee e1 WHERE e1.month < (SELECT MAX(e2.month) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.id = e1.id)) SELECT f.id, f.month, SUM(e.salary) AS Salary FROM filtered f JOIN Employee e ON f.id = e.id AND e.month BETWEEN f.month - 2 AND f.month GROUP BY f.id, f.month ORDER BY f.id, f.month DESC;
game-play-analysis-iii: SELECT player_id, event_date, SUM(games_played) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY event_date) AS games_played_so_far FROM Activity;
customer-placing-the-largest-number-of-o: SELECT customer_number FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_number HAVING COUNT(order_number) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_number)) LIMIT 1;
friend-requests-i-overall-acceptance-rat: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT requester_id, accepter_id FROM RequestAccepted)), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sender_id, send_to_id FROM FriendRequest)), 0), 2) AS accept_rate;
classes-with-at-least-5-students: SELECT class FROM Courses GROUP BY class HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT student) >= 5;
friend-requests-ii-who-has-the-most-frie: SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS num FROM (SELECT requester_id AS id FROM RequestAccepted UNION ALL SELECT accepter_id FROM RequestAccepted) t GROUP BY id ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 1;
tree-node: SELECT id, CASE WHEN p_id IS NULL THEN 'Root' WHEN id IN (SELECT p_id FROM Tree WHERE p_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Inner' ELSE 'Leaf' END AS Type FROM Tree ORDER BY id;
shortest-distance-in-a-plane: SELECT ROUND(MIN(SQRT((p1.x - p2.x) * (p1.x - p2.x) + (p1.y - p2.y) * (p1.y - p2.y))), 2) AS shortest FROM Point2D p1 JOIN Point2D p2 ON p1.x < p2.x OR (p1.x = p2.x AND p1.y < p2.y);
shortest-distance-in-a-line: SELECT MIN(p2.x - p1.x) AS shortest FROM (SELECT x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY x) AS rn FROM Point) p1 JOIN (SELECT x, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY x) AS rn FROM Point) p2 ON p1.rn = p2.rn - 1;
biggest-single-number: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM (SELECT num FROM MyNumbers GROUP BY num HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);
swap-sex-of-employees: UPDATE Salary SET sex = CASE sex WHEN 'm' THEN 'f' ELSE 'm' END; SELECT id, name, sex, salary FROM Salary ORDER BY id;
exchange-seats: SELECT s1.id, COALESCE(s2.student, s1.student) AS student FROM Seat s1 LEFT JOIN Seat s2 ON s2.id = ((s1.id + 1) / 2) * 2 - (s1.id % 2) ORDER BY s1.id;
students-report-by-geography: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'America' THEN name END) AS America, MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'Asia' THEN name END) AS Asia, MAX(CASE WHEN continent = 'Europe' THEN name END) AS Europe FROM (SELECT name, continent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY continent ORDER BY name) AS rn FROM Student) t GROUP BY rn;
unpopular-books: SELECT book_id, name FROM Books b WHERE available_from <= date('2019-06-10', '-1 month') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.book_id = b.book_id AND o.dispatch_date BETWEEN date(b.available_from, '+1 month') AND '2019-06-10');
new-users-daily-count: SELECT login_date, user_count FROM (SELECT activity_date AS login_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count FROM Traffic WHERE activity = 'login' GROUP BY activity_date) t WHERE login_date BETWEEN '2019-05-30' AND '2019-06-30';
reported-posts: SELECT action_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) AS post_count FROM Actions WHERE action = 'report' AND extra = 'spam' GROUP BY action_date;
active-businesses: SELECT business_id FROM Events GROUP BY business_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'reviews' THEN occurrences ELSE 0 END) >= 1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'complaints' THEN occurrences ELSE 0 END) < 2;
user-purchase-platform: SELECT spend_date, SUM(CASE WHEN platform = 'desktop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop, SUM(CASE WHEN platform = 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile, SUM(CASE WHEN platform = 'both' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both FROM (SELECT spend_date, user_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT platform) = 2 THEN 'both' ELSE MAX(platform) END AS platform FROM Spending GROUP BY spend_date, user_id) t GROUP BY spend_date;
reported-posts-ii: SELECT a.post_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.action_date) AS daily_blacklist_per_post FROM Actions a JOIN Removals r ON a.post_id = r.post_id WHERE a.action = 'report' AND a.extra = 'spam' AND a.action_date <= r.remove_date GROUP BY a.post_id;
user-activity-for-the-past-30-days-i: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM Activity WHERE activity_date BETWEEN date('2019-07-27', '-29 days') AND '2019-07-27' GROUP BY activity_date;
user-activity-for-the-past-30-days-ii: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM (SELECT user_id, activity_date, date(activity_date, '-' || (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_date) - 1) || ' days') AS grp FROM Activity WHERE activity_date BETWEEN date('2019-07-27', '-29 days') AND '2019-07-27') t GROUP BY user_id, grp HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;
product-price-at-a-given-date: SELECT product_id, new_price AS price FROM Products WHERE (product_id, change_date) IN (SELECT product_id, MAX(change_date) FROM Products WHERE change_date <= '2019-08-16' GROUP BY product_id);
market-analysis-ii: SELECT u.user_id AS seller_id, i.item_brand AS item_brand, u.favorite_brand AS seller_brand FROM Users u JOIN Orders o ON u.user_id = o.seller_id JOIN Items i ON o.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.item_brand != u.favorite_brand GROUP BY u.user_id, i.item_brand, u.favorite_brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.buyer_id) >= 2;
monthly-transactions-i: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', trans_date) AS month, country, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount FROM Transactions GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', trans_date), country;
last-person-to-fit-in-the-bus: SELECT person_name FROM (SELECT person_name, SUM(weight) OVER (ORDER BY turn) AS running FROM Queue) WHERE running <= 1000 ORDER BY running DESC LIMIT 1;
monthly-transactions-ii: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', trans_date) AS month, country, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS trans_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN id END) AS approved_count, SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount FROM Transactions GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', trans_date), country;
report-contiguous-dates: WITH all_dates AS (SELECT fail_date AS date, 'failed' AS period_state FROM Failed UNION ALL SELECT success_date, 'succeeded' FROM Succeeded), filtered AS (SELECT date, period_state FROM all_dates WHERE date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'), grouped AS (SELECT date, period_state, date(date, '-' || (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period_state ORDER BY date) - 1) || ' days') AS grp FROM filtered) SELECT period_state, MIN(date) AS start_date, MAX(date) AS end_date FROM grouped GROUP BY period_state, grp ORDER BY start_date;
average-selling-price: SELECT u.product_id, ROUND(SUM(p.price * u.units) * 1.0 / SUM(u.units), 2) AS average_price FROM UnitsSold u JOIN Prices p ON u.product_id = p.product_id AND u.purchase_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date GROUP BY u.product_id;
find-the-start-and-end-number-of-continu: WITH ordered AS (SELECT log_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_id) AS rn FROM Logs) SELECT MIN(log_id) AS start_id, MAX(log_id) AS end_id FROM ordered GROUP BY log_id - rn;
restaurant-growth: SELECT visited_on, amount, ROUND(AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS average_amount, ROUND(100.0 * (amount - LAG(amount, 7) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on)) / LAG(amount, 7) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on), 2) AS percentage_change FROM Customer;
ads-performance: SELECT ad_id, ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'Clicked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'Clicked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('Clicked', 'Viewed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, 2) AS ctr FROM Ads GROUP BY ad_id;
number-of-transactions-per-visit: SELECT transactions_count, COUNT(*) AS visits_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(t.amount) AS transactions_count FROM Visits v LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON v.user_id = t.user_id AND v.visit_date = t.transaction_date GROUP BY v.user_id, v.visit_date) x GROUP BY transactions_count ORDER BY transactions_count;
movie-rating: SELECT results FROM (SELECT u.name AS results FROM Users u JOIN MovieRating m ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', m.created_at) = '2020-02' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.name LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT results FROM (SELECT mo.title AS results FROM Movies mo JOIN MovieRating m ON mo.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', m.created_at) = '2020-02' GROUP BY mo.movie_id, mo.title ORDER BY AVG(m.rating) DESC, mo.title LIMIT 1);
activity-participants: SELECT activity FROM Friends GROUP BY activity HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
get-the-second-most-recent-activity: SELECT username, activity, startDate, endDate FROM (SELECT username, activity, startDate, endDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY username ORDER BY startDate DESC) AS rn FROM UserActivity) t WHERE rn = 2;
running-total-for-different-genders: SELECT gender, day, SUM(score_points) OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY day) AS total FROM Scores ORDER BY gender, day;
capital-gainloss: SELECT stock_name, SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'Buy' THEN -price ELSE price END) AS capital_gain_loss FROM Stocks GROUP BY stock_name;
total-sales-amount-by-year: SELECT product_id, strftime('%Y', period_start) AS sales_year, SUM(average_daily_sales * (CAST(julianday(period_end) - julianday(period_start) AS INTEGER) + 1)) AS total_amount FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id, strftime('%Y', period_start);
active-users: SELECT name AS account FROM Accounts a WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT login_date) FROM Logins l WHERE l.id = a.id AND strftime('%Y-%m', login_date) = '2020-06') >= 5;
evaluate-boolean-expression: SELECT left_operand, operator, right_operand, CASE operator WHEN '>' THEN CASE WHEN left_operand > right_operand THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END WHEN '<' THEN CASE WHEN left_operand < right_operand THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END WHEN '=' THEN CASE WHEN left_operand = right_operand THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END END AS value FROM Expressions;
apples-oranges: SELECT sale_date, SUM(CASE WHEN fruit = 'apples' THEN sold_num ELSE 0 END) AS apples, SUM(CASE WHEN fruit = 'oranges' THEN sold_num ELSE 0 END) AS oranges FROM Sales GROUP BY sale_date;
group-sold-products-by-the-date: SELECT sell_date, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS num_sold, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product) AS products FROM Activities GROUP BY sell_date;
sales-by-day-of-the-week: SELECT CASE CAST(strftime('%w', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week, SUM(CASE WHEN i.item_category = 'B' THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS B, SUM(CASE WHEN i.item_category = 'F' THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS F FROM Orders o JOIN Items i ON o.item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY strftime('%w', o.order_date);
patients-with-a-condition: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions LIKE '% DIAB1%' OR conditions LIKE 'DIAB1%';
customer-order-frequency: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM Orders WHERE order_date >= date((SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM Orders), '-1 year') GROUP BY customer_id;
the-most-recent-three-orders: SELECT customer_name, customer_id, order_id, order_date FROM (SELECT c.name AS customer_name, o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY customer_name, customer_id, order_date DESC, order_id DESC;
friendly-movies-streamed-last-month: SELECT DISTINCT c.title AS content FROM Content c JOIN TVProgram t ON c.content_id = t.content_id WHERE c.content_type = 'Movies' AND c.Kids_content = 'Y' AND strftime('%Y-%m', t.program_date) = '2020-02' ORDER BY c.title LIMIT 2;
find-users-with-valid-e-mails: SELECT user_id, name FROM Users WHERE mail GLOB '*@*.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z]*' AND mail NOT LIKE '%..%' AND mail NOT LIKE '%@.%' AND mail NOT LIKE '%.@%' AND mail NOT LIKE '%@-%' AND mail NOT LIKE '%-@%';
bank-account-summary: SELECT user_id, user_name, credit - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN paid_by = user_id THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN paid_to = user_id THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS balance FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON u.user_id = t.paid_by OR u.user_id = t.paid_to GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.credit HAVING balance > 10000 OR balance < 0;
unique-orders-and-customers-per-month: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM Orders GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date);
hopper-company-queries-i: WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT month + 1 FROM months WHERE month < 12), drivers_count AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', join_date) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(driver_id) AS drivers_count FROM Drivers WHERE strftime('%Y', join_date) = '2020' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', join_date)), rides_count AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(a.ride_id) AS accepted_rides FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id WHERE strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) = '2020' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.requested_at)) SELECT m.month, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.drivers_count) FROM drivers_count d WHERE d.month <= m.month), 0) AS active_drivers, COALESCE((SELECT rc.accepted_rides FROM rides_count rc WHERE rc.month = m.month), 0) AS accepted_rides FROM months m ORDER BY m.month;
hopper-company-queries-ii: WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT month + 1 FROM months WHERE month < 12), drivers_count AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', join_date) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(driver_id) AS drivers_count FROM Drivers WHERE strftime('%Y', join_date) = '2020' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', join_date)), working_drivers AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT a.driver_id) AS working_drivers FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id WHERE strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) = '2020' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.requested_at)) SELECT m.month, ROUND(COALESCE(1.0 * wd.working_drivers / NULLIF(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.drivers_count) FROM drivers_count d WHERE d.month <= m.month), 0), 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS working_percentage FROM months m LEFT JOIN working_drivers wd ON m.month = wd.month ORDER BY m.month;
hopper-company-queries-iii: WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT month + 1 FROM months WHERE month < 12), monthly AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', r.requested_at) AS INTEGER) AS month, SUM(a.ride_distance) AS monthly_distance, SUM(a.ride_duration) AS monthly_duration FROM Rides r LEFT JOIN AcceptedRides a ON r.ride_id = a.ride_id WHERE strftime('%Y', r.requested_at) = '2020' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.requested_at)), joined AS (SELECT m.month, COALESCE((SELECT monthly_distance FROM monthly x WHERE x.month = m.month), 0) AS monthly_distance, COALESCE((SELECT monthly_duration FROM monthly x WHERE x.month = m.month), 0) AS monthly_duration FROM months m WHERE m.month <= 10) SELECT month, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(monthly_distance) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING), 0) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_distance, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(monthly_duration) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING), 0) / 3.0, 2) AS average_ride_duration FROM joined ORDER BY month;
average-time-of-process-per-machine: SELECT a.machine_id, ROUND(AVG(b.timestamp - a.timestamp), 3) AS processing_time FROM Activity a JOIN Activity b ON a.machine_id = b.machine_id AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.activity_type = 'start' AND b.activity_type = 'end' GROUP BY a.machine_id;
fix-names-in-a-table: SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN name = UPPER(name) THEN name WHEN name = LOWER(name) THEN UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(name, 2)) ELSE name END AS name FROM Users ORDER BY user_id;
number-of-calls-between-two-persons: SELECT MIN(from_id, to_id) AS person1, MAX(from_id, to_id) AS person2, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(duration) AS total_duration FROM Calls GROUP BY MIN(from_id, to_id), MAX(from_id, to_id);
recyclable-and-low-fat-products: SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE low_fats = 'Y' AND recyclable = 'Y';
products-price-for-each-store: SELECT product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store1' THEN price END) AS store1, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store2' THEN price END) AS store2, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store3' THEN price END) AS store3 FROM Products GROUP BY product_id;
primary-department-for-each-employee: SELECT employee_id, department_id FROM Employee GROUP BY employee_id HAVING MAX(primary_flag) = 'Y';
find-interview-candidates: SELECT name FROM Users WHERE user_id IN (SELECT gold_medal FROM Contests UNION SELECT silver_medal FROM Contests UNION SELECT bronze_medal FROM Contests) GROUP BY user_id, name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
convert-date-format: SELECT day, CAST(strftime('%d', day) AS INTEGER) || '-' || CASE strftime('%m', day) WHEN '01' THEN 'Jan' WHEN '02' THEN 'Feb' WHEN '03' THEN 'Mar' WHEN '04' THEN 'Apr' WHEN '05' THEN 'May' WHEN '06' THEN 'Jun' WHEN '07' THEN 'Jul' WHEN '08' THEN 'Aug' WHEN '09' THEN 'Sep' WHEN '10' THEN 'Oct' WHEN '11' THEN 'Nov' WHEN '12' THEN 'Dec' END || '-' || strftime('%Y', day) AS formatted_date FROM Days;
suspicious-bank-accounts: SELECT account_id FROM (SELECT t.account_id, MAX(a.max_income) AS max_income, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'creditor' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net FROM Transactions t JOIN Accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id) x WHERE max_income > 90000 AND cnt > 1 AND net > 2500000;
page-recommendations-ii: SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id AS recommended_id FROM Likes l JOIN Friendship f ON l.user_id = f.user1_id OR l.user_id = f.user2_id WHERE l.page_id NOT IN (SELECT page_id FROM Likes WHERE user_id = CASE WHEN f.user1_id = l.user_id THEN f.user2_id ELSE f.user1_id END);
users-that-actively-request-confirmation: WITH confirmation_time_cte AS (SELECT user_id, strftime('%s', LEAD(time_stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY time_stamp)) - strftime('%s', time_stamp) AS time_diff FROM Confirmations) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM confirmation_time_cte WHERE time_diff <= 86400;
league-statistics: WITH match_score AS (SELECT home_team_id, away_team_id, home_team_goals, away_team_goals, CASE WHEN home_team_goals > away_team_goals THEN 3 WHEN home_team_goals = away_team_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS home_score, CASE WHEN home_team_goals < away_team_goals THEN 3 WHEN home_team_goals = away_team_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS away_score FROM Matches), team_score AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_score AS score, home_team_goals AS goal_for, away_team_goals AS goal_against FROM match_score UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, away_score, away_team_goals, home_team_goals FROM match_score) SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS matches_played, SUM(s.score) AS points, SUM(s.goal_for) AS goal_for, SUM(s.goal_against) AS goal_against, SUM(s.goal_for) - SUM(s.goal_against) AS goal_diff FROM team_score s INNER JOIN Teams t ON s.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY points DESC, goal_diff DESC, t.team_name;
confirmation-rate: WITH rate_cte AS (SELECT user_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS confirmation_rate FROM Confirmations GROUP BY user_id) SELECT s.user_id, COALESCE(r.confirmation_rate, 0) AS confirmation_rate FROM Signups s LEFT JOIN rate_cte r ON s.user_id = r.user_id;
first-and-last-call-on-the-same-day: SELECT user_id FROM (SELECT caller_id AS user_id, MIN(date(call_time)) AS fd, MAX(date(call_time)) AS ld FROM Calls GROUP BY caller_id UNION ALL SELECT recipient_id, MIN(date(call_time)), MAX(date(call_time)) FROM Calls GROUP BY recipient_id) t WHERE fd = ld;
the-number-of-seniors-and-juniors-to-joi: WITH senior_cte AS (SELECT employee_id, salary_accu FROM (SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Senior') a WHERE salary_accu <= 70000), senior_max_cte AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(salary_accu), 0) AS salary FROM senior_cte), junior_cte AS (SELECT employee_id FROM (SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Junior') a WHERE salary_accu + (SELECT salary FROM senior_max_cte) <= 70000) SELECT 'Senior' AS experience, COUNT(*) AS accepted_candidates FROM senior_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'Junior', COUNT(*) FROM junior_cte;
count-the-number-of-experiments: WITH Platforms(platform) AS (SELECT 'Android' UNION ALL SELECT 'IOS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Web'), ExperimentNames(experiment_name) AS (SELECT 'Reading' UNION ALL SELECT 'Sports' UNION ALL SELECT 'Programming') SELECT p.platform, e.experiment_name, COUNT(exp.experiment_id) AS num_experiments FROM Platforms p CROSS JOIN ExperimentNames e LEFT JOIN Experiments exp ON p.platform = exp.platform AND e.experiment_name = exp.experiment_name GROUP BY p.platform, e.experiment_name;
employees-with-missing-information: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees WHERE employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Salaries) UNION SELECT employee_id FROM Salaries WHERE employee_id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employees);
the-number-of-seniors-and-juniors-to-joi: WITH senior_cte AS (SELECT employee_id, salary_accu FROM (SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Senior') a WHERE salary_accu <= 70000), senior_max_cte AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(salary_accu), 0) AS salary FROM senior_cte), junior_cte AS (SELECT employee_id FROM (SELECT employee_id, SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary, employee_id) AS salary_accu FROM Candidates WHERE experience = 'Junior') a WHERE salary_accu + (SELECT salary FROM senior_max_cte) <= 70000) SELECT employee_id FROM senior_cte UNION ALL SELECT employee_id FROM junior_cte;
account-balance: SELECT account_id, day, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY day) AS balance FROM Transactions;
build-the-equation: SELECT power, factor FROM Terms ORDER BY power DESC;
the-airport-with-the-most-traffic: WITH flight_counts AS (SELECT airport_id, SUM(flights_count) AS flights_count FROM (SELECT departure_airport AS airport_id, flights_count FROM Flights UNION ALL SELECT arrival_airport, flights_count FROM Flights) x GROUP BY airport_id) SELECT airport_id FROM flight_counts WHERE flights_count = (SELECT MAX(flights_count) FROM flight_counts);
the-number-of-passengers-in-each-bus-ii: WITH RECURSIVE arrival_time_cte AS (SELECT b.bus_id, b.arrival_time, b.capacity, COUNT(p.passenger_id) AS prefix_sum FROM Buses b LEFT JOIN Passengers p ON p.arrival_time <= b.arrival_time GROUP BY b.bus_id, b.arrival_time, b.capacity), ordered AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY arrival_time) AS rn FROM arrival_time_cte), alloc AS (SELECT bus_id, arrival_time, capacity, prefix_sum, rn, CASE WHEN capacity < prefix_sum THEN capacity ELSE prefix_sum END AS passengers_cnt, CASE WHEN capacity < prefix_sum THEN capacity ELSE prefix_sum END AS accum FROM ordered WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.bus_id, o.arrival_time, o.capacity, o.prefix_sum, o.rn, CASE WHEN o.capacity < o.prefix_sum - a.accum THEN o.capacity ELSE o.prefix_sum - a.accum END, a.accum + CASE WHEN o.capacity < o.prefix_sum - a.accum THEN o.capacity ELSE o.prefix_sum - a.accum END FROM ordered o JOIN alloc a ON o.rn = a.rn + 1) SELECT bus_id, passengers_cnt FROM alloc ORDER BY bus_id;
finding-the-topic-of-each-post: SELECT p.post_id, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT k.topic_id), 'Ambiguous!') AS topic FROM Posts p LEFT JOIN Keywords k ON (' ' || LOWER(p.content) || ' ') LIKE ('% ' || LOWER(k.word) || ' %') GROUP BY p.post_id;
longest-winning-streak: WITH player_match_seq AS (SELECT player_id, match_day, result, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_day) AS seq FROM Matches), player_match_group AS (SELECT player_id, seq - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_day) AS group_id FROM player_match_seq WHERE result = 'Win'), streaks AS (SELECT player_id, group_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_match_group GROUP BY player_id, group_id) SELECT a.player_id, COALESCE(MAX(b.cnt), 0) AS longest_streak FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM Matches) a LEFT JOIN streaks b ON a.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id;
the-users-that-are-eligible-for-discount: SELECT user_id FROM Purchases GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(amount) >= 100;
dynamic-pivoting-of-a-table: SELECT product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store1' THEN price END) AS store1, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store2' THEN price END) AS store2, MAX(CASE WHEN store = 'store3' THEN price END) AS store3 FROM Products GROUP BY product_id;
dynamic-unpivoting-of-a-table: SELECT product_id, 'LC_Store' AS store, LC_Store AS price FROM Products WHERE LC_Store IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Nozama', Nozama FROM Products WHERE Nozama IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Shop', Shop FROM Products WHERE Shop IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'Souq', Souq FROM Products WHERE Souq IS NOT NULL;
tasks-count-in-the-weekend: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%w', submit_date) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7 >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%w', submit_date) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7 < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS working_cnt FROM Tasks;
the-number-of-users-that-are-eligible-fo: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_cnt FROM Purchases WHERE time_stamp >= '2022-03-08' AND time_stamp <= '2022-03-20' AND amount >= 1000;
arrange-table-by-gender: WITH genders_cte AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY user_id) AS rnk1, CASE gender WHEN 'female' THEN 1 WHEN 'other' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS rnk2 FROM Genders) SELECT user_id, gender FROM genders_cte ORDER BY rnk1, rnk2;
change-null-values-in-a-table-to-the-pre: WITH rn_cte AS (SELECT id, drink, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rn FROM CoffeeShop), group_cte AS (SELECT id, drink, rn, SUM(CASE WHEN drink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS group_id FROM rn_cte) SELECT id, MAX(drink) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id) AS drink FROM group_cte ORDER BY rn;
employees-with-deductions: SELECT e.employee_id FROM Employees e LEFT JOIN Logs l ON e.employee_id = l.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM((strftime('%s', l.out_time) - strftime('%s', l.in_time) + 59) / 60) / 60.0, 0) < MAX(e.needed_hours);
form-a-chemical-bond: WITH metal_cte AS (SELECT symbol FROM Elements WHERE type = 'Metal'), nonmetal_cte AS (SELECT symbol FROM Elements WHERE type = 'Nonmetal') SELECT m.symbol AS metal, n.symbol AS nonmetal FROM metal_cte m CROSS JOIN nonmetal_cte n;
concatenate-the-name-and-the-profession: SELECT person_id, name || '(' || SUBSTR(profession, 1, 1) || ')' AS name FROM Person ORDER BY person_id DESC;
count-artist-occurrences-on-spotify-rank: SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM Spotify GROUP BY artist ORDER BY occurrences DESC, artist ASC;
find-active-users: WITH active_users_cte AS (SELECT user_id, CASE WHEN julianday(created_at) - julianday(LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at)) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM Users) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM active_users_cte WHERE active = 1;
consecutive-transactions-with-increasing: WITH date_group_cte AS (SELECT *, julianday(transaction_date) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS date_group FROM Transactions), increasing_date_group_cte AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN amount <= LAG(amount, 1, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, date_group ORDER BY transaction_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start FROM date_group_cte), group_cte AS (SELECT *, SUM(start) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS group_id FROM increasing_date_group_cte) SELECT customer_id, MIN(transaction_date) AS consecutive_start, MAX(transaction_date) AS consecutive_end FROM group_cte GROUP BY customer_id, group_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY customer_id;
customers-with-maximum-number-of-transac: WITH group_cte AS (SELECT customer_id, CAST(julianday(transaction_date) - julianday(MIN(transaction_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id)) AS INTEGER) + 1 - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS diff FROM Transactions), cnt_cte AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM group_cte GROUP BY customer_id, diff) SELECT customer_id FROM cnt_cte WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM cnt_cte) ORDER BY customer_id;
flight-occupancy-and-waitlist-analysis: SELECT flight_id, MIN(passenger_cnt, capacity) AS booked_cnt, MAX(passenger_cnt - capacity, 0) AS waitlist_cnt FROM (SELECT a.flight_id, a.capacity, COUNT(b.flight_id) AS passenger_cnt FROM Flights a LEFT JOIN Passengers b ON a.flight_id = b.flight_id GROUP BY a.flight_id, a.capacity) t ORDER BY flight_id;
rolling-average-steps: WITH avg_cte AS (SELECT s1.user_id, s1.steps_date, COUNT(s2.steps_date) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(s2.steps_count), 2) AS rolling_average FROM Steps s1 JOIN Steps s2 ON s1.user_id = s2.user_id AND julianday(s2.steps_date) BETWEEN julianday(s1.steps_date) - 2 AND julianday(s1.steps_date) GROUP BY s1.user_id, s1.steps_date) SELECT user_id, steps_date, rolling_average FROM avg_cte WHERE cnt = 3 ORDER BY user_id, steps_date;
find-peak-calling-hours-for-each-city: WITH call_by_hour AS (SELECT city, CAST(strftime('%H', call_time) AS INTEGER) AS calling_hour, COUNT(*) AS number_of_calls FROM Calls GROUP BY city, calling_hour), rank_calling_hour AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY number_of_calls DESC) AS rnk FROM call_by_hour) SELECT city, calling_hour AS peak_calling_hour, number_of_calls FROM rank_calling_hour WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY peak_calling_hour DESC, city DESC;
top-three-wineries: WITH rank_cte AS (SELECT country, winery, SUM(points) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC, winery) AS rnk FROM Wineries GROUP BY country, winery) SELECT country, MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END) AS top_winery, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 2 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END), 'No second winery') AS second_winery, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 3 THEN winery || ' (' || total || ')' END), 'No third winery') AS third_winery FROM rank_cte WHERE rnk <= 3 GROUP BY country ORDER BY country;
friday-purchases-ii: WITH date_cte(week_of_month, purchase_date) AS (SELECT 1, '2023-11-03' UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2023-11-10' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '2023-11-17' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '2023-11-24') SELECT a.week_of_month, a.purchase_date, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount_spend), 0) AS total_amount FROM date_cte a LEFT JOIN Purchases b ON a.purchase_date = b.purchase_date GROUP BY a.week_of_month, a.purchase_date ORDER BY a.week_of_month;
viewers-turned-streamers: WITH sessions_cte AS (SELECT user_id, session_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY session_start) AS rnk, SUM(CASE WHEN session_type = 'Streamer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS sessions_count FROM Sessions) SELECT user_id, sessions_count FROM sessions_cte WHERE rnk = 1 AND session_type = 'Viewer' AND sessions_count > 0 ORDER BY sessions_count DESC;
friday-purchases-i: SELECT CAST(strftime('%W', purchase_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%W', '2023-11-01') AS INTEGER) + 1 AS week_of_month, purchase_date, SUM(amount_spend) AS total_amount FROM Purchases WHERE strftime('%w', purchase_date) = '5' GROUP BY purchase_date ORDER BY week_of_month;
maximize-items: WITH prime_cte AS (SELECT item_type, CAST(500000 / SUM(square_footage) AS INTEGER) * COUNT(*) AS item_count, CAST(500000 / SUM(square_footage) AS INTEGER) * SUM(square_footage) AS total FROM Inventory WHERE item_type = 'prime_eligible'), not_prime_cte AS (SELECT item_type, CAST((500000 - (SELECT total FROM prime_cte)) / SUM(square_footage) AS INTEGER) * COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Inventory WHERE item_type = 'not_prime') SELECT item_type, item_count FROM prime_cte UNION SELECT item_type, item_count FROM not_prime_cte ORDER BY item_count DESC;
snaps-analysis: SELECT age_bucket, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'send' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS send_perc, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'open' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS open_perc FROM Activities a1 LEFT JOIN Age a2 ON a1.user_id = a2.user_id GROUP BY age_bucket;
find-trending-hashtags: SELECT hashtag, COUNT(*) AS hashtag_count FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#'), INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1) || ' ', ' ')) AS hashtag FROM Tweets WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29' AND INSTR(tweet, '#') > 0) GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC, hashtag DESC LIMIT 3;
find-all-unique-email-domains: SELECT SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) AS email_domain, COUNT(*) AS count FROM Emails WHERE email LIKE '%.com' GROUP BY email_domain ORDER BY email_domain;
user-activities-within-time-bounds: WITH diff_cte AS (SELECT *, (strftime('%s', LEAD(session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, session_type ORDER BY session_start)) - strftime('%s', session_end)) / 3600.0 AS diff FROM Sessions) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM diff_cte WHERE diff <= 12 ORDER BY user_id;
calculate-trapping-rain-water: WITH left_right_max AS (SELECT *, MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS left_max, MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) AS right_max FROM Heights) SELECT SUM(MIN(left_max, right_max) - height) AS total_trapped_water FROM left_right_max;
find-trending-hashtags-ii: SELECT hashtag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#'), INSTR(SUBSTR(tweet, INSTR(tweet, '#') + 1) || ' ', ' ')) AS hashtag FROM Tweets WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29' AND INSTR(tweet, '#') > 0) GROUP BY hashtag ORDER BY count DESC, hashtag DESC LIMIT 3;
find-bursty-behavior: WITH posts_in_7_days AS (SELECT p1.user_id, p1.post_date, COUNT(*) AS sevenday_posts FROM Posts p1 JOIN Posts p2 ON p1.user_id = p2.user_id AND julianday(p2.post_date) BETWEEN julianday(p1.post_date) - 6 AND julianday(p1.post_date) GROUP BY p1.user_id, p1.post_date), max_posts AS (SELECT user_id, MAX(sevenday_posts) AS max_7day_posts FROM posts_in_7_days GROUP BY user_id), avg_weekly AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) / 4.0 AS avg_weekly_posts FROM Posts WHERE post_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-28' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT m.user_id, m.max_7day_posts, a.avg_weekly_posts FROM max_posts m INNER JOIN avg_weekly a ON m.user_id = a.user_id WHERE m.max_7day_posts >= 2 * a.avg_weekly_posts ORDER BY m.user_id;
find-longest-calls: WITH rank_cte AS (SELECT c.contact_id AS id, c.type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.type ORDER BY c.duration DESC) AS row_num, printf('%02d:%02d:%02d', c.duration / 3600, (c.duration % 3600) / 60, c.duration % 60) AS duration_formatted FROM Calls c), top3 AS (SELECT * FROM rank_cte WHERE row_num <= 3) SELECT ct.first_name, t.type, t.duration_formatted FROM top3 t INNER JOIN Contacts ct ON t.id = ct.id ORDER BY t.type, t.duration_formatted DESC, ct.first_name DESC;
invalid-tweets-ii: SELECT tweet_id FROM Tweets WHERE LENGTH(content) > 140 OR (LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '@', ''))) > 3 OR (LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '#', ''))) > 3 ORDER BY tweet_id;
friday-purchase-iii: WITH weeks_cte(week_of_month) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4), memberships_cte(membership) AS (SELECT 'Premium' UNION ALL SELECT 'VIP'), friday_purchases AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%W', purchase_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%W', '2023-11-01') AS INTEGER) + 1 AS week_of_month, u.membership, SUM(p.amount_spend) AS total_amount FROM Purchases p INNER JOIN Users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE strftime('%w', p.purchase_date) = '5' GROUP BY week_of_month, u.membership) SELECT w.week_of_month, m.membership, COALESCE(f.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount FROM weeks_cte w CROSS JOIN memberships_cte m LEFT JOIN friday_purchases f ON w.week_of_month = f.week_of_month AND m.membership = f.membership ORDER BY w.week_of_month, m.membership;
server-utilization-time: WITH diff_cte AS (SELECT strftime('%s', LEAD(status_time) OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY status_time)) - strftime('%s', status_time) AS diff, session_status FROM Servers) SELECT CAST(SUM(diff) / 86400 AS INTEGER) AS total_uptime_days FROM diff_cte WHERE session_status = 'start';
employee-task-duration-and-concurrent-ta: WITH time_cte AS (SELECT employee_id, start_time AS time FROM Tasks UNION SELECT employee_id, end_time FROM Tasks), segments AS (SELECT employee_id, time AS start_time, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY time) AS end_time FROM time_cte), counts AS (SELECT s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM segments s INNER JOIN Tasks t ON s.employee_id = t.employee_id WHERE s.start_time >= t.start_time AND s.end_time <= t.end_time GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time) SELECT employee_id, CAST(SUM((strftime('%s', end_time) - strftime('%s', start_time)) * CASE WHEN cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 3600 AS INTEGER) AS total_task_hours, MAX(cnt) AS max_concurrent_tasks FROM counts GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY employee_id;
calculate-parking-fees-and-duration: WITH info_cte AS (SELECT car_id, lot_id, SUM(strftime('%s', exit_time) - strftime('%s', entry_time)) AS duration FROM ParkingTransactions GROUP BY car_id, lot_id), max_info AS (SELECT car_id, MAX(duration) AS max_duration FROM info_cte GROUP BY car_id), max_duration_lot AS (SELECT a.car_id, a.lot_id AS most_time_lot FROM info_cte a INNER JOIN max_info b ON a.car_id = b.car_id AND a.duration = b.max_duration), total_cte AS (SELECT car_id, SUM(fee_paid) AS total_fee_paid, SUM(strftime('%s', exit_time) - strftime('%s', entry_time)) AS total_duration FROM ParkingTransactions GROUP BY car_id) SELECT a.car_id, t.total_fee_paid, ROUND(t.total_fee_paid * 3600.0 / t.total_duration, 2) AS avg_hourly_fee, a.most_time_lot FROM max_duration_lot a INNER JOIN total_cte t ON a.car_id = t.car_id ORDER BY a.car_id;
second-day-verification: SELECT e.user_id FROM emails e INNER JOIN texts t ON e.email_id = t.email_id WHERE t.signup_action = 'Verified' AND CAST(julianday(t.action_date) - julianday(e.signup_date) AS INTEGER) = 1 ORDER BY e.user_id;
find-top-scoring-students-ii: WITH best_enrollments AS (SELECT student_id, course_id, MIN(grade) AS grade FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id, course_id), major_mandatory_a AS (SELECT s.student_id, s.major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM best_enrollments e INNER JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id INNER JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.major = c.major AND c.mandatory = 'yes' AND e.grade = 'A' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.major), major_mandatory_total AS (SELECT major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM courses WHERE mandatory = 'yes' GROUP BY major), major_elective_ab AS (SELECT s.student_id, s.major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM best_enrollments e INNER JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id INNER JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.major = c.major AND c.mandatory = 'no' AND e.grade <= 'B' GROUP BY s.student_id, s.major), gpa_cte AS (SELECT student_id, AVG(gpa) AS gpa FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id) SELECT c1.student_id FROM major_mandatory_a c1 INNER JOIN major_mandatory_total c2 ON c1.major = c2.major INNER JOIN major_elective_ab c3 ON c1.student_id = c3.student_id INNER JOIN gpa_cte c4 ON c1.student_id = c4.student_id WHERE c1.cnt = c2.cnt AND c3.cnt >= 2 AND c4.gpa >= 2.5 ORDER BY c1.student_id;
bitwise-user-permissions-analysis: WITH RECURSIVE ordered AS (SELECT user_id, permissions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS rn FROM user_permissions), bit_and_cte AS (SELECT permissions AS common_perms, permissions AS any_perms, rn FROM ordered WHERE rn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT b.common_perms & o.permissions, b.any_perms | o.permissions, o.rn FROM bit_and_cte b JOIN ordered o ON o.rn = b.rn + 1) SELECT common_perms, any_perms FROM bit_and_cte ORDER BY rn DESC LIMIT 1;
find-overlapping-shifts-ii: WITH time_cte AS (SELECT employee_id, start_time AS time FROM EmployeeShifts UNION SELECT employee_id, end_time FROM EmployeeShifts), segments AS (SELECT employee_id, time AS start_time, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY time) AS end_time FROM time_cte), counts AS (SELECT s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM segments s INNER JOIN EmployeeShifts e ON s.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE s.start_time >= e.start_time AND s.end_time <= e.end_time GROUP BY s.employee_id, s.start_time, s.end_time), max_count AS (SELECT employee_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_overlapping_shifts FROM counts GROUP BY employee_id), overlap AS (SELECT e1.employee_id, CAST((strftime('%s', CASE WHEN e1.end_time < e2.end_time THEN e1.end_time ELSE e2.end_time END) - strftime('%s', e2.start_time)) / 60 AS INTEGER) AS overlap_duration FROM EmployeeShifts e1 INNER JOIN EmployeeShifts e2 ON e1.employee_id = e2.employee_id WHERE e1.start_time < e2.start_time AND e1.end_time > e2.start_time), total_duration AS (SELECT employee_id, SUM(overlap_duration) AS total_overlap_duration FROM overlap GROUP BY employee_id) SELECT m.employee_id, m.max_overlapping_shifts, COALESCE(t.total_overlap_duration, 0) AS total_overlap_duration FROM max_count m LEFT JOIN total_duration t ON m.employee_id = t.employee_id ORDER BY m.employee_id;
longest-team-pass-streak: WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (SELECT t1.team_name AS team1, t2.team_name AS team2, p.time_stamp FROM Passes p INNER JOIN Teams t1 ON p.pass_from = t1.player_id INNER JOIN Teams t2 ON p.pass_to = t2.player_id), sorted_edges AS (SELECT team1, team2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY team1 ORDER BY time_stamp) AS rnk FROM edges), scores AS (SELECT team1, team2, rnk, CASE WHEN team1 = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS score FROM sorted_edges WHERE rnk = 1 UNION ALL SELECT s.team1, s.team2, s.rnk, CASE WHEN s.team1 = s.team2 THEN sc.score + 1 ELSE 0 END FROM sorted_edges s INNER JOIN scores sc ON s.rnk = sc.rnk + 1 AND s.team1 = sc.team1) SELECT team1 AS team_name, MAX(score) AS longest_streak FROM scores GROUP BY team1 HAVING longest_streak > 0 ORDER BY team_name;
first-letter-capitalization: WITH RECURSIVE split AS (SELECT content_id, content_text, SUBSTR(content_text || ' ', 1, INSTR(content_text || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS word, SUBSTR(content_text || ' ', INSTR(content_text || ' ', ' ') + 1) AS remain, 1 AS idx FROM user_content UNION ALL SELECT content_id, content_text, SUBSTR(remain, 1, INSTR(remain, ' ') - 1), SUBSTR(remain, INSTR(remain, ' ') + 1), idx + 1 FROM split WHERE remain != ''), formatted AS (SELECT content_id, content_text, idx, UPPER(SUBSTR(word, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(word, 2)) AS formatted_word FROM split WHERE word != '') SELECT content_id, content_text AS original_text, GROUP_CONCAT(formatted_word, ' ') AS converted_text FROM formatted GROUP BY content_id, content_text ORDER BY content_id;
find-circular-gift-exchange-chains: WITH RECURSIVE cycles AS (SELECT giver_id, receiver_id, gift_value, giver_id AS start FROM SecretSanta UNION ALL SELECT s.giver_id, s.receiver_id, s.gift_value, c.start FROM SecretSanta s INNER JOIN cycles c ON s.giver_id = c.receiver_id AND s.giver_id != c.start), triples AS (SELECT start, COUNT(*) AS chain_length, SUM(gift_value) AS total_gift_value FROM cycles GROUP BY start), unique_pairs AS (SELECT chain_length, total_gift_value FROM triples GROUP BY chain_length, total_gift_value) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY chain_length DESC, total_gift_value DESC) AS chain_id, chain_length, total_gift_value FROM unique_pairs;
find-cities-in-each-state-ii: SELECT state, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(city, ', ') FROM (SELECT city FROM cities c2 WHERE c2.state = c1.state ORDER BY city)) AS cities, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(city, 1, 1) = SUBSTR(state, 1, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_letter_count FROM cities c1 GROUP BY state HAVING COUNT(city) >= 3 AND matching_letter_count >= 1 ORDER BY matching_letter_count DESC, state;
find-valid-emails: SELECT user_id, email FROM Users WHERE email LIKE '%_@__%.__%' AND email NOT LIKE '%@%@%' AND SUBSTR(email, -4) = '.com' AND SUBSTR(email, 1, INSTR(email, '@') - 1) NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_]*' AND SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1, LENGTH(email) - INSTR(email, '@') - 4) NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z]*' ORDER BY user_id;
find-products-with-three-consecutive-dig: WITH RECURSIVE pos(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM pos WHERE n < 100) SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.name FROM products p JOIN pos ON n <= LENGTH(p.name) - 2 WHERE SUBSTR(p.name, n, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTR(p.name, n + 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTR(p.name, n + 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND (n = 1 OR SUBSTR(p.name, n - 1, 1) NOT BETWEEN '0' AND '9') AND (n + 2 = LENGTH(p.name) OR SUBSTR(p.name, n + 3, 1) NOT BETWEEN '0' AND '9') ORDER BY p.product_id;
find-invalid-ip-addresses: WITH RECURSIVE octets AS (SELECT log_id, ip, 1 AS idx, CAST(SUBSTR(ip, 1, INSTR(ip || '.', '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS val, SUBSTR(ip, INSTR(ip, '.') + 1) AS rest FROM logs UNION ALL SELECT log_id, ip, idx + 1, CAST(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest || '.', '.') - 1) AS INTEGER), CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, '.') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, '.') + 1) END FROM octets WHERE idx < 4 AND INSTR(ip, '.') > 0), invalid AS (SELECT DISTINCT log_id, ip FROM octets WHERE val > 255 OR val < 0 OR ip NOT LIKE '%.%.%.%' OR ip LIKE '%..%' OR LENGTH(ip) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ip, '.', '')) != 3 UNION SELECT log_id, ip FROM logs WHERE ip GLOB '*[^0-9.]*') SELECT ip, COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM invalid GROUP BY ip ORDER BY invalid_count DESC, ip DESC;
